description: Report only the invoices that have line items, ranked by how many line items they have.

a.request: For each invoice that has at least one line item, show the invoice number, the average ratio of `derived_total_cost` to `derived_product_cost` across its line items, and its number of line items. List the 10 invoices with the most line items, from most to fewest.
a.sql: SELECT invoice_number, AVG(derived_total_cost / NULLIF(derived_product_cost, 0)) AS average_cost_ratio, COUNT(*) AS line_item_count FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number ORDER BY line_item_count DESC, invoice_number ASC LIMIT 10;

c.request: For each invoice, show the invoice number, the average ratio of `derived_total_cost` to `derived_product_cost` across its line items, and how many line items it has. Give the 10 invoices with the most line items, from most to fewest. Report only the invoices that have line items, ranked by how many line items they have.
c.sql: SELECT i.invoice_number, AVG(1.0 * ili.derived_total_cost / NULLIF(ili.derived_product_cost, 0)) AS average_cost_ratio, COUNT(*) AS line_item_count FROM Invoices AS i JOIN Invoice_Line_Items AS ili ON ili.invoice_number = i.invoice_number GROUP BY i.invoice_number ORDER BY line_item_count DESC, i.invoice_number ASC LIMIT 10

d.request: For each invoice with at least one line item, show its invoice number, the average of `derived_total_cost / derived_product_cost` across its line items, and its line-item count; return the 10 invoices with the highest counts, ordered from most line items to fewest.
d.sql: SELECT invoice_number, AVG(derived_total_cost / NULLIF(derived_product_cost, 0)) AS average_cost_ratio, COUNT(*) AS line_item_count FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number ORDER BY line_item_count DESC LIMIT 10;
